import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset from iris.csv
iris = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv', names=['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width', 'species'])

# Map species to numerical values for plotting
species_map = {'setosa': 0, 'versicolor': 1, 'virginica': 2}
iris['species'] = iris['species'].map(species_map)

# Create a scatter plot of petal length vs petal width for each species
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
sns.scatterplot(x='petal_length', y='petal_width', hue='species', data=iris)

# Add title and axis labels
plt.title('Petal Length vs Petal Width by Species')
plt.xlabel('Petal Length (cm)')
plt.ylabel('Petal Width (cm)')

# Add legend and save the figure

import pandas as pd

species_map = {'setosa': 0, 'versicolor': 1, 'virginica': 2}

# Create a scatter plot of petal length vs petal width for each species
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
sns.scatterplot(x='petal_length', y='petal_width', hue='species', data=iris)

plt.title('Petal Length vs Petal Width by Species')
